name: Beef Jerky & Meat Sticks (Tough Leathery Protein Warning)
whyItWorks: Dehydrated beef strips are tough, fibrous, and leathery. They require intense mechanical grinding by molars; swallowed chunks remain dense and fibrous in the stomach, while high sodium, black pepper, and nitrates irritate mucosal ulcers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid tough dried jerky during active disease. For high-protein snacks, choose soft string cheese, hard-boiled eggs, or sliced deli turkey breast.
watchOuts: Dense leathery meat fibers and black pepper seasoning irritate ulcerations and increase stricture transit difficulty.
